decision.explanation: The two documents present conflicting accounts of Friedrich II. von Parsberg’s identity and career. Document d1 describes a 14th–15th century individual who served as Bishop of Eichstätt, while d2 describes a 15th–16th century individual who served as Prince-Bishop of Augsburg and later Count of Astarac. These accounts cannot be reconciled as referring to the same person due to incompatible timelines and roles. Each account independently supports one position, so both are listed as separately justified.
